## Checklist

### Code quality

- [ ] Code follows the project's style guidelines
- [ ] Self-reviewed the diff before requesting review
- [ ] No commented-out code, debug logs, or leftover TODOs
- [ ] No hardcoded secrets, credentials, or environment-specific values

### Testing

- [ ] Added/updated unit tests covering the change
- [ ] Added/updated integration tests (if applicable)
- [ ] All tests pass locally
- [ ] Manually tested the change (describe below)

**Manual testing notes:**

<!-- e.g. "Tested login flow with expired token on staging" -->

### Documentation

- [ ] Updated README / docs (if applicable)
- [ ] Updated inline code comments where logic isn't self-explanatory

### Dependencies & migrations

- [ ] No new dependencies added, OR new dependencies are justified below
- [ ] Database migrations included and reversible (if applicable)
- [ ] Environment variables / config changes documented (if applicable)

### Security & performance

- [ ] Reviewed for potential security issues (input validation, auth checks, etc.)
- [ ] No obvious performance regressions introduced
- [ ] No new lint/type errors
- [ ] Local scanner(s) ran and passed
